name: Kanban Board
description: A drag-and-drop task board for a space. Collaborators organize work as cards in colour-coded columns: add, rename, recolour, reorder and delete columns, drag cards between them, and keep a short label and details on each card; the first editor to open an empty board gets To do, In progress and Done. Viewers and anyone the frame is published to see the board live and read-only. The board is the kanban_columns and kanban_cards tables in the space's frame data, synced with the space.
